proof_scope: Full 2027 period in the actual Chromium/Bun/SQLite/Planner test host, with the original 5000 ms interaction assertions. Own agenda, preservation, retry, comparison, source navigation and revocation consumers are exercised. Source/history catalog, C06 messages and source/review host callbacks in this browser journey are controlled. This is a functional regression witness, not a general performance benchmark, native installation mount, physical historical continuity or C16 native/MCP parity. Actual Chromium, browser client and contribution view over an HTTP display/navigation fixture with a complete shared-schema envelope explicitly labelled fixture-not-native-evidence. Each navigation reauthorizes the output and expected digest; revoke, stale output, changed links, superseded requests and disposal refuse disclosure. Retry access preserves request digest pins, missing runProvenance is rejected, provenance/source fields render and denial clears them. The complete fixture envelope is neither a verified native run nor a C11 producer/reader or installation-mount witness.
